turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting resistance welding electrode diagnostic and qualification procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the initial electrode inspection. Check the electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than one millimeter or mushrooming, examine the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage, and inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: initial inspection complete electrode cap faces show minor surface wear but no deep pitting or mushrooming, shank contact surfaces clean and coolant ports are clear

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do you observe electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming, or cracking?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no caps are in servicable condition with only normal wear

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode face diameter within the wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah face diameter still within acceptable limits per spec

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes both electrodes showing adequate flow rates above min spec

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode force within plus or minus five percent of the programmed schedule value?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The force reading is jumping around erratically between 20% and 80% of the target value, it won't stabilize at all.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no measured force reading about eight percent low on load cell

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the pneumatic pressure regulator on the electrode arm to bring the force into specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pneumatic pressure regulator on electrode arm

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: regulator adjustment complete increased presure setting to compensate

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pneumatic pressure regulator on electrode arm

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the electrode force after the regulator adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: ok so force now reading within tolerance right at target value

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the measured weld current within plus or minus three percent of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The current reading looks okay, but I'm seeing the secondary transformer coil temperature spiking way above normal—like 180 degrees—and that's not one of the options here.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah weld monitor shows peak current within two percent of schedule

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the weld time within plus or minus one cycle of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes scope trace confirms weld time right on taget

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the electrode faces parallel with a contact pattern above ninety percent of the face area?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I check that, do you know if we're supposed to log this downtime in the new maintenance tracking system or are we still using the old spreadsheets?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes carbon transfer pattern shows full concentric contact across both electrode faces

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the pilot weld appearance show no spatter, expulsion, or surface cracks?

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah all five pilot welds look clean no visible defects or expulsion

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the weld nugget diameter meet the minimum for material thickness?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes ultrasonic scan shows nugget dim exceeds min requirement

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the peel test show button pull failure mode with no interfacial fracture?

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no seeing interfacial fracture on two of the samples instead of full button pull

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Revise the weld schedule and increase heat input incrementally to improve fusion.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: schedule revised increased current by two percent and extended weld time slighty

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the peel test result after the schedule revision.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: looks like much better all samples now show full button pull with good nugget formation

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Did the weld controller backup complete successfully?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The backup completed, but I'm getting a warning light on the weld controller display that says 'electrode wear threshold exceeded' — should I address that first or continue?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes backup transfered to server and verified file timestamp is current

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the coolant return temperature within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no return line temp running about five degrees above max spec

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Check the chiller setpoint and clean the condenser to restore proper cooling performance.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: chiller setpoint corrected and condenser cleaned temp now back in range

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run twenty consecutive production welds at standard schedule settings. Log the weld current, force, and time for each weld, then inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing intermittent arc flashing between the upper electrode holder and the shank during the weld cycle, but the current readings look normal on the display.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: production qualification run complete all twenty welds logged and final five spots look consistant

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all production qualification welds within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no three of the welds showing parameters outside control limits

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure cannot be completed due to persistent peel test failure. Escalate this issue to the weld engineer for metallurgical review before returning the machine to production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: peel test failure persistent, metallurgical review

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: understood will escalate to weld engineer and tag machine out of service

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: peel test failure persistent, metallurgical review
